messages:
deploybot: Preflight: deploy job started for migration 2026-03-21_add_user_email_idx on prod cluster. Canary group=10% traffic, app pinned to v2.5.0-canary. Preflight steps: run FK-checks on shadow tables, run small backfill, validate reads.

sam: kicking off preflight checks now. running `pg_checks fk_integrity --schema=shadow_users --limit=1000`. will post failures.

dbadmin: FYI the migration adds a concurrent index and then a constraint validation step. if FK conflicts found we must abort and run targeted reconcile.

renee: tagging product: product-lead can we pause feature rollout if we need to abort?

product-lead: yes we can toggle feature-flag user-email-lookup off in 2 mins. prefer graceful degradation rather than rollback if possible.

DeployBot: Preflight step 1 complete: shadow FK-check returned 7 failures on shard 5. Details: user_id references missing in users_archive.

sam: that's unexpected. those rows should have been reconciled by last nightly job. pulling sample ids now: `SELECT id FROM shadow_users WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users_archive WHERE users_archive.id=shadow_users.user_id) LIMIT 10;`

renee: if those ids are old churn, we can either backfill from source data lake or skip them with safemode flag. what's the risk?

dbadmin: skipping validation will leave dangling refs; app code tolerates null emails but other services assume referential integrity for archival workflow. I'd prefer targeted reconcile.

oncall-sre: threshold check: if we abort now it's low blast radius. Aborting after index apply would be higher risk. Recommend abort canary and run reconcile job.

sam: agree. plan: abort canary -> run reconcile job for shard 5 -> re-run preflight -> resume canary. commands: `/deploybot abort 6185559999 --reason "preflight FK failures"` then `/jobs run reconcile_shard --shard=5 --priority=high`

DeployBot: Abort acknowledged. Canary rollout canceled for migration 2026-03-21_add_user_email_idx. Pin remains in place; promotion halted.

renee: toggling feature-flag now to reduce downstream consumer impact: `/ff toggle user-email-lookup off --scope=production`

product-lead: confirmed flag off. monitoring for errors.

sam: launching reconcile job now. estimate 8-12 minutes. tailing logs: `job://reconcile_shard/2026-03-21-1`

dbadmin: reconcile strategy: for each missing user_id, try lookup in backups -> populate users_archive -> mark reconciled. If unresolved after retries, write to reconciliation queue for manual review.

sam: reconcile progress: 0/7 -> 4/7 -> 7/7 reconciled. logs show two rows required merge from backup-2026-03-20-02.

oncall-sre: replication impact minimal. CPU bump on shard 5 while reconcile ran but within limits. No lag >20s.

sam: reconcile complete. re-running preflight checks.

DeployBot: Preflight step 1 re-run complete: 0 FK failures. Ready to retry canary.

renee: can we remove app pin for the canary group only and run a smaller sanity wave first? product wants to keep global pin until we confirm no regressions.

sam: plan: run micro-wave 5% with app pinned group switched to v2.5.0-canary (we'll unpin only the canary hosts), run smoke suite 3m, then continue per runbook. Command: `/deploybot promote 6185559999 --to=5% --note "micro-wave post-reconcile"`

product-lead: ok from product. will watch metrics.

DeployBot: Micro-wave promotion started -> 5% traffic.

sam: smoke suite running: queries ok, p95 stable, no new errors.

dbadmin: index apply will be run as `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS idx_users_email ON users (email);` final constraint validation deferred.

oncall-sre: watching SLOs. queue depth normal.

sam: micro-wave healthy at 5%. escalating to 25% per plan. `/deploybot promote 6185559999 --to=25%`

DeployBot: Promotion to 25% done.

renee: release notes draft: "Added concurrent index on users.email. Canary run paused for preflight reconciliation; resolved missing archive references and resumed canary. App pinned to v2.5.0-canary during validation." Will push to #release-notes after full rollout.

sam: full rollout scheduled in 30m after extended watch. if any rollback triggers hit (replication lag >30s, error-rate >2%, deadlocks >4/min), abort and open incident.

product-lead: thanks team. thumbs up.

DeployBot: Thread closed by deploybot: post-action watch window set 30m. Logs: job://deploy/6185559999.
